text: APPROVE. Both versions return the first object entry when no version is requested, and the first object entry whose string `num` equals the requested version otherwise. The extracted `MatchesRequested` keeps that logic and the complexity drops well below 15, because the `continue` branches, the nested `if` and the `&&` chain move out of `Parse`. The new code is a plain static helper with valid nullable and pattern syntax, so I see nothing that would break the warnings-as-errors build.
